subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — live URL embed, dev-server preview, browser-backed inspection

question: What trusted preview boundary should OpenClaw support for dashboard URL embeds, agent-owned dev servers, and browser-backed console/network/screenshot inspection?
rationale: Current main has only generic plugin-tab and iframe sandbox primitives, while the requested later phases expose process and browser state that need maintainer-defined trust and permission rules before implementation.

options.title: Read-only preview first
options.body: Land a narrow embed/reload/viewport widget first, while keeping dev-server spawning and browser inspection behind separate security review.

options.title: Wait for dashboard substrate
options.body: Defer this issue until the dashboard workspace stack lands cleanly, then implement against the final widget APIs.

options.title: Broaden into browser panel design
options.body: Fold the preview work into a larger browser-control/login-handoff design with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/63926 before implementation.

recommendation.title: Read-only preview first
recommendation.body: Land a narrow embed/reload/viewport widget first, while keeping dev-server spawning and browser inspection behind separate security review.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior plugin-tab precedent and browser-preview cleanup history make steipete the strongest available product/security routing owner.
